_readme: ACHIEVEMENTS. 08-progression.md §9 - one-time objectives with points, Clout,
Fragments and, for the memorable ones, titles and profile frames.
WHY THIS IS AN ACCUMULATOR AND MISSIONS ARE NOT. Mission progress is recomputed
from a bounded log of finished matches, so any claim can be re-derived and
audited. That log holds 200 matches and is pruned to the oldest held mission's
window. 'Complete 500 matches' cannot be answered from it, and neither can
'activate all 9 Confluences (lifetime)'. So achievements keep a running tally,
credited once per match, exactly like Faction Mastery - and, exactly like
Faction Mastery, that means the credit has to be right the first time because
there is nothing to recompute from.
FOUR REQUIREMENT KINDS, AND NOTHING ELSE. 'total' sums a per-match statistic
over every match ever played. 'best' takes the largest single-match value.
'distinct' counts different values seen (factions won with, Confluences fired,
modes played). 'account' reads a fact about the account itself rather than
about matches - cards owned, cosmetics owned, best mastery rank. Anything that
cannot be phrased in those four is an achievement that cannot be verified, and
this project has shipped enough rewards that quietly failed to track.
POINTS AND MILESTONES. §9 puts profile frames at 250 / 500 / 1,000 achievement
points. The 26 achievements below are worth 635 points, of which 625 are
reachable offline (Front Row Seat needs a server). So 250 and 500 ship and are
listed here; 1,000 is deliberately NOT listed, because a milestone nobody can
reach is an invisible reward, which is the one thing this codebase refuses to
grant. checkAchievementsData() asserts every listed milestone is reachable, so
the day the set grows past 1,000 the omission reports itself.
REWARDS FOLLOW THE MASTERY RULE. A cosmetic reward is granted only if it names
a 'ref' that resolves to something the game can actually display. One that does
not is listed in DEFERRED_ACHIEVEMENTS with a written reason, and the screen
says what it is waiting for rather than offering a Claim that pays nothing.
